claims.text: Zhyzhak, a homid Ahroun of the Black Spiral Dancers at Rank 5, is a long favourite of the Green Dragon totem, the source of the Dancer’s monstrous strength.
Zhyzhak rose quickly to Warder of the Trinity Hive Caern, a hive set inside the gut of a colossal Thunderwyrm the Dancers call Grammaw.
In Crinos Zhyzhak stands ten feet tall in black fur, and always shouts rather than speaks.
Among Zhyzhak’s rites is the Rite of Arterial Introduction (level two), which lets new Dancers enter Grammaw’s bloodstream without being burned or confused.

title: Voragg the Unbound
summary: A Bane freed from a Rocky Mountains prison.

claims.text: Voragg has served the Wyrm for centuries, mostly while bound in a rock deep under the Rocky Mountains, where a Wendigo tribe sealed it after it troubled them in the late 1500s.
A construction worker named Hector Fritz broke it loose by jackhammering through a marked stone rather than report the find, and Voragg took over Hector body and soul.
Its master, the Eater-of-Souls, pays it no heed, and it now roams California at the nominal head of a fomori pack that has plans of its own for it.
Sister Judith is a metis Theurge of Rank 4 who serves first as a healer and keeps clear of local Garou politics.
Judith shows uncannily accurate foresight and a strong bond with the living land; tales say saplings rise from desert dust and leprosy is healed at a touch.
Light blazes from Judith’s white paws while working Gifts, and most Furies grant that Gaia favours this healer.

title: Mari Cabrah
summary: A Black Fury Theurge and rival of Albrecht.

claims.text: Mari Cabrah is a homid Theurge of the Black Furies at Rank 3, with Pure Breed among the Backgrounds.
Mari and Lord Albrecht clash and later reconcile; by the time of their fight the two are about equal in power.
Jubati, a homid Ragabash of Rank 2, counts Balam and Mokole among close allies and learns from a native elder.
Jubati carries Tsansti’s Blowgun, a level four fetish once owned by an Uktena hero: ten feet long, with a forty-yard range and a five-die damage pool used only to pierce armour.
In Lupus Jubati is a sleek wolf with reddish fur, and has a mild phobia of heavy machinery.
